name: Toushin Toshi II - Soshite, Sorekara...
original_name: 闘神都市II そして、それから・・・
source:
Returning from the goddess tournament, Seed is reduced to level 1 by the Demon King. His dojo sent him to a training journey, but Hazuki was so worried about him that she followed Seed and got into trouble herself.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
從鬥神大會歸來後，席德被魔王降至1級。道場讓他踏上修行之旅，但葉月太過擔心他，便跟隨席德出發，也讓自己陷入麻煩。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
